flip_heatmaps_TTA: flip heatmaps horizontally for test-time augmentation with symmetric keypoint index swapping
flip_vectors_TTA: flip instance-level x and y vector labels for test-time augmentation with keypoint swapping
flip_coordinates_TTA: flip normalized keypoint coordinates for test-time augmentation with optional coordinate shifting
flip_visibility_TTA: flip keypoint visibility tensor for test-time augmentation using symmetric keypoint indices
aggregate_heatmaps: aggregate multiple heatmaps by averaging or concatenating with optional bilinear resizing
